text:
maria: Heads-up — I found a few customer sessions where we charged the full toolcall after a streaming session truncated and then we fell back to a smaller model. Feels like double-crediting across stream_end + toolcall_complete.

ashok: ugh. do you have the ledger/trace for one example? call_id dedupe should prevent this but maybe we missed a path.

maria: minimal trace below (sanitized):
```
request_id=rcp_9f3a
user=acct_123
initial_model=redwood-6b
stream_chunks=3
stream_end_reason=client_reconnect
fallback_model=redwood-3b-quant
toolcall_result=partial
tokens_reported_by_stream=120
tokens_reported_by_toolcall=120
call_id=call_abc
events=["streaming.chunk", "streaming.end", "toolcall.dispatch", "toolcall.complete"]
```

jordan: console shows the route used fallback -> cheaper model, but billing shows full 6b charge. Is the runtime emitting both a stream token event and a separate toolcall charge?

maria: yes, that's what ledger lines imply — we get a `stream_end` token attribution and later a `toolcall_complete` that re-credits same tokens under the toolcall meter.

ashok: probable cause: when client reconnects we surface a synthetic `stream_end` for the previous session and then the toolcall finishes normally. Our current dedupe only keys on `call_id` but the `stream_end` path doesn't include `call_id`, so it creates a separate ledger row.

jordan: could we attach `call_id` to stream summaries? or make the billing pipeline coalesce by (request_id, user, approx_tokens, time_window) as a fallback?

maria: quick mitigation ideas: 1) when fallback path is taken, mark the stream_end as provisional (no final charge) until toolcall_complete. 2) attach `call_id` to stream_end events so dedupe works. I can prototype #1 in billing-sim.

ashok: +1 to attaching `call_id` if feasible. fallback/provisional flag seems lower-risk short term. Add a telemetry tag `fallback_path=partial_toolcall` so we can query incidence.

runtime-bot: incident created: INC-1209 (auto) — tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-platform for follow-up.

billing-bot: FYI — created provisional credit run for affected accounts, will coordinate with CS.

maria: I'll open a tiny RFC with the proposed change (attach call_id to stream_end + provisional flag) and include unit tests for the ledger merger. Will ping @ashok @jordan for review.

jordan: thanks — also let's add a small console tooltip explaining provisional credits so customers don't freak out when they see temporary charges. :slightly_smiling_face:
